summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed; recommendation: keep new public exposure, go-live, and security-sensitive releases blocked pending dated control evidence. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: the security fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 61 site legal-family facts are unknown; TLS has no certificate-expiry alerts but configuration evidence is absent; secrets handling, authentication boundaries, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are not evidenced. Risk severity: high for unverified release controls and public exposure, evidence gap rather than proof of compromise. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.

Retain the existing private launch gate for security-sensitive products. The available evidence supports only preview/private operation: source rights, data-flow retention, consent configuration, accuracy, measurement, and security gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible site growth is not blocked when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries.

The compliance baseline reports 35 passes, 20 failures, and 6 unknowns across 61 sites, but the supplied evidence does not identify every affected site or prove a specific security defect. Treat aggregate scan failures and unreachable checks as evidence gaps requiring site-specific artifacts before remediation or launch decisions; do not infer missing disclosures or controls.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and release gates
items.summary: Fleet-wide security clearance is unsupported because fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results and material controls remain unevidenced. Preserve private launch and security-sensitive release gates while permitting bounded reversible growth that introduces no new credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.
items.requested_action: Continue one consolidated, read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record evidence timestamps, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deployment controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain risk, data exposure, monitoring and incident response, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or claim certification.
